purpose: Freeze the exact Ministry of Finance event-level source and aggregation contract for announced RON domestic interbank primary-market government-securities supply. This contract materialises announced target supply only and does not estimate any yield effect.

concept.name: announced RON primary-market supply level
concept.economic_meaning: Nominal amount of RON government securities officially scheduled/offered through Ministry domestic primary-market auctions and benchmark SSON sessions.

official_source_family.publication_family: Monthly orders approving issuance prospectuses for discount Treasury bills and benchmark government bonds
official_source_family.legal_market_boundary: Government debt-management operations on the domestic government-securities market administered by the National Bank of Romania under the Ministry/BNR primary-market framework.

monthly_order_structure.article_1: Freezes the order-level nominal total for Annexes 1 and 2 plus the separately stated maximum SSON allocation.
monthly_order_structure.annex_2: Benchmark-bond reference auctions and supplementary non-competitive offer sessions (SSON).

event_schema.instrument_identity_rule: Use ISIN when printed in the source. If a source row lacks ISIN, retain an exact source-row instrument identity composed from source_id, annex, auction date, issue date and maturity date; never invent an ISIN.

T_BILL_COMPETITIVE_REFERENCE_AUCTION.amount_field: Valoare emisiune lei / exact equivalent printed target field

BENCHMARK_BOND_COMPETITIVE_REFERENCE_AUC.amount_field: Valoare nominala licitatie de referinta Lei

BENCHMARK_BOND_SSON.interpretation: Announced supplementary non-competitive allocation capacity. It is ex-ante announced primary supply, not realised borrowing.

aggregation_rules.monthly_bucket_rule: Aggregate each row by its own event_date. Competitive auction targets use Data licitatiei; SSON targets use Data SSON. Do not bucket all rows by source-order month.
aggregation_rules.monthly_formula: sum(announced_nominal_RON_million for included event rows whose event_date is in month)
aggregation_rules.document_reconciliation_formula: sum(all Annex 1 competitive targets + all Annex 2 competitive targets) == Article 1 base nominal total; sum(all Annex 2 SSON targets) == Article 1 SSON maximum; combined row sum == Article 1 document total.
aggregation_rules.retained_flash_crosscheck_role: Independent exact cross-check where the retained Flash vintage contains the same announced schedule; it is not the primary source.

publication_time_rules.reason: The signed Ministry order date is the exact authoritative date available in the source document. HTTP Last-Modified is transport metadata and is not treated as the economic announcement time.

explicit_exclusions: cash-management instruments unless a future separate contract explicitly includes them
exchange operations unless a future separate contract explicitly includes them

next_task.scope: Retain the January-March 2025 Ministry orders, extract Annex 1 and Annex 2 event rows exactly, reconcile component sums to Article 1 totals and retained Flash announced totals where available, then produce an event-level and monthly pilot reference-mode artifact through 2025-03-31.
